actions.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /app
if ! command -v qemu-system-x86_64 >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'qemu-system-x86_64 missing' >&2; exit 1; fi
nohup qemu-system-x86_64 -m 512 -nographic -serial telnet:127.0.0.1:6665,server,nowait -drive file=/app/alpine.iso,media=cdrom,format=raw -boot d >/tmp/alpine-qemu.log 2>&1 &
echo $!

actions.notes: If the ISO does not boot to a login prompt with the initial QEMU invocation, inspect /tmp/alpine-qemu.log and adjust boot/device flags while preserving the requirement to expose the guest console on 127.0.0.1:6665.
